messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• Texas law allows a 5 mph “speed‑limit tolerance” for drivers who are traveling at or below the posted limit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑seat or booster.
• The “child‑seat” must be appropriate for the child’s height and weight. | Texas Transportation Code §§545.001, 545.002 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Lower BAC limits apply to commercial drivers (0.04%) and drivers under 21 (0.02%). | Texas Transportation Code §§545.001, 545.002 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Stop signs and traffic signals must be obeyed. | Texas Transportation Code §§545.001–545.004 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• The bus’s stop lights must be flashing. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Drivers must signal before changing lanes.
• Overtaking is prohibited on one‑way streets with a solid white line. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited unless marked otherwise. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Toll Roads & Bridges** | • Texas has several toll roads (e.g., Sam Houston Tollway).
• Electronic toll collection (TxTag) is required for frequent use. | TxDOT website | | **Special Provisions** | • Texas has specific rules for “high‑way” vs. “local” roads, “commercial” vs. “private” vehicles, and “motorcycle” licensing. | Texas Transportation Code | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: https://www.txdot.gov/ - **Texas Transportation Code** – Accessible online via the Texas Legislature’s website. - **Local County Courts** – For recent case law or local ordinances that may affect traffic rules. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to comply with a particular regulation!
